cut: Two actual incoming-family promotions of the four coefficient rows, followed by their raw/from-indexed/to-indexed presentations. Retain all labels, endpoint fields, aggregate values, masses and recursive members. No cone or FCC wrapper is included.
cut_equivalence: Exact equality of the complete three presentations at fixed labelled ports and policy, with the same index/unindex comparison functions. This suffices to exhibit equivalence without erasing any retained field.
target_class: Prepared stationary single-mode Markov input-output models with explicit internal-bath occupation n>=0, fixed external preparation, coupling rates and detuning. Bath preparation is part of the model boundary condition, not quotiented away.
target_observation: Added external output occupation N_add=|q|^2*n, in the existing source convention.
target_equivalence: Preserve the external/bath port interpretation, prepared bath state, and external response/noise observations; different N_add at the same external preparation separates prepared models.
rival: The cut retains the transfer-coefficient domain but not the full prepared stochastic/quantum domain. Full-packet recovery cannot recover an input absent from that packet.
predicted_falsifier: Complete identical cut presentations for both occupations, but different added output occupation.
positive_control: Changing the actual bath coupling and regenerating all records changes the retained cut; nested members must not be erased to produce a collision.
scope_guard: A collision refutes this frozen cut map as a representation of the prepared thermal domain. It does not refute the existence of a different WG source/cut retaining occupation, nor full recovery of the coefficient-only domain. A preparation difference must not be relabelled as a difference of unprepared dynamics.
